data.name: Krutika
data.gender_notes: Krutika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Krutika is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Krut' meaning 'to do'. This name symbolizes the one who performs God's will and is an embodiment of His divine plan. It is believed that the name bestows strength, courage, and determination on the bearer. The name Krutika carries the meaning “Instrument of God's will” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Krutika usually hope their child will grow to embody instrument of god's will and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Krutika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Instrument of God's will.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Krutika total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
